metadata.description: SDD Kit: spec-driven development for Claude Code. A stack-agnostic core plugin (/sdd front door, workflows, agents, skills, hooks) plus optional stack, preset and tool add-ons.

plugins.name: sdd-kit
plugins.description: SDD Kit: spec-driven development for Claude Code. A single /sdd front door, six background multi-agent workflows with stack detection and cross-repo support, specialized agents and skills, and guardrail hooks. Stack-agnostic core; stacks come from add-on plugins.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-design
plugins.description: UI design add-on: ui-ux-advisor agent and design-ui skill. Third-party design skills are listed in docs/third-party.md.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-devenv
plugins.description: Dev-environment add-on: docker and ddev skills, plus an optional DDEV MCP entry. Not tied to a stack.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-drupal
plugins.description: Drupal 11 add-on: drupal-11 skill with module scaffolding.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-ios
plugins.description: iOS/Swift add-on: ios-mobile-dev agent, ios-native (with SwiftUI code templates in its assets) and swift-testing skills.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-laravel
plugins.description: Laravel add-on: laravel-backend-dev agent, Laravel, Pest, Passport, DTO, service-repository, event-driven and migration skills, path-scoped rules, the contract-sync template and the Laravel stack manifest.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-laravel-nextjs
plugins.description: Compatibility preset for SDD Kit 2.x users: installs the core plugin with the Laravel, Next.js and dev-environment add-ons. Ships no components of its own.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js add-on: nextjs-frontend-dev agent, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind skills, path-scoped rules and the Next.js and Nuxt stack manifests.

plugins.name: sdd-kit-ops
plugins.description: Operations add-on: deploy, rollback, feature flags, health checks, incident response, and ops analysis agents.
